faq_q1: How are course resources delivered and downloaded on the website?
faq_a1: All group-bought and purchased course resources are stored on high-speed Google Drive and backup cloud servers. After purchasing on the course detail page, download links and credentials are immediately unlocked and synchronized to your User Center under [My Orders].
faq_q2: What is the decompression password for downloaded archives?
faq_a2: The general site password is: ggcstudio or ggc.studio (lowercase, no spaces). Any specialized archives with unique passwords will be noted next to their download links.
faq_q3: What should I do if extraction says 'Archive corrupted' or 'Missing volume/part'?
faq_a3: Large CG video courses use multi-part compression (.part1.rar, .part2.rar). Make sure all parts are fully downloaded into the same directory. We recommend WinRAR 6.x+ or 7-Zip on Windows, and Keka or The Unarchiver on macOS. If errors persist, use WinRAR's 'Tools -> Repair archive' feature.
faq_q4: What exclusive privileges do Supreme VIP members receive?
faq_a4: Supreme VIP members enjoy maximum 30% discounts, unlimited downloads across digital resources, 24-hour early access to new Masterclass courses, priority high-speed Drive links, and accelerated course sourcing requests.
faq_q5: How do I contact customer support or resolve order/account issues?
faq_a5: If you experience order activation delays or need a link refreshed, post in the Forum under [Feedback & Support] or contact our community support channels. Administrators will assist and re-upload files promptly.
